test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

Based on the above, how is K related to P if ‘J ÷ K + L × O – P’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png]

father

Given: J ÷ K + L × O – P 

J ÷ K → J is the daughter of K.

K + L → K is the sister of L.

L × O → L is the father of O.​

O – P → O is the brother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04b5766fa1e80d7d0cc55280641e12368d64be21a424b857e1618f833cece9a6.png] 

Here, K is the parental aunt or father's sister of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
